input: Your APR will be between 8.99% and 24.99% based on your creditworthiness. Annual fee: $0.

meta.rule: Reg Z disclosure must state the APR range when the actual APR is not yet determined.

input: Low interest rates available! Apply now and save thousands.

meta.rule: Reg Z requires APR disclosure in credit advertising; vague terms like 'low interest rates' without a specific APR are non-compliant.

input: FDIC-insured up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, for each ownership category.

meta.rule: FDIC advertising rules require the official insurance statement when promoting deposit products.

input: Guaranteed 12% returns on our high-yield savings account. No risk.

meta.rule: FDIC ad rules prohibit claims of guaranteed returns or characterizing deposit products as risk-free beyond insurance limits.

input: This is not a deposit, is not insured by the FDIC, and may lose value. The investment is offered through our broker-dealer subsidiary.

meta.rule: When a bank sells non-deposit investment products, disclosures must state the product is not FDIC-insured and may lose value.
meta.expected_quote: not insured by the FDIC, and may lose value

input: Refinance with us at 3.5% and skip your next two payments — guaranteed.

meta.rule: Reg Z requires clear, prominent triggering-term disclosures (APR, terms, conditions) when specific rates are advertised; skipping payments must include the effect on total cost of credit.

input: By providing your phone number, you consent to receive marketing calls and texts at this number. Reply STOP to opt out.

meta.rule: TCPA requires express written consent for marketing autodialed calls/texts and a clear opt-out mechanism.

input: Your data will be shared with our affiliates and partners as needed.

meta.rule: GLBA privacy notice must describe categories of nonpublic personal information collected and shared, and offer an opt-out where applicable. Vague 'as needed' language is insufficient.
